name: BambooHR Thomas2Go Café: Scratch Roasted Turkey, Havarti/Cheddar & Avocado Sandwich or Panini
brandOrRestaurant: Thomas2Go / Thomas Cuisine Café at BambooHR (Lindon / Draper, UT)
